description: Source code for the PeriodClosingVoucher class in ERPNext, handling period closing voucher operations such as validation, GL entry creation, and balance calculations.

classes.name: PeriodClosingVoucher
classes.description: Class representing a period closing voucher with methods for validation, GL entry creation, and balance calculations.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the voucher by checking account head and posting date.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Reverses GL entries when the voucher is canceled.

methods.name: validate_account_head
methods.description: Validates that the closing account is of type Liability or Equity and matches company currency.

methods.name: validate_posting_date
methods.description: Validates the posting date against fiscal year and existing entries.

methods.name: make_gl_entries
methods.description: Generates GL entries based on account balances.

methods.name: get_gl_entries
methods.description: Retrieves GL entries for profit and loss accounts.

methods.name: get_pnl_gl_entry
methods.description: Creates GL entries for profit and loss accounts.

methods.name: update_default_dimensions
methods.description: Updates GL entries with default accounting dimensions.

methods.name: get_pl_balances
methods.description: Calculates balances for dimension-wise profit and loss accounts.
